public.aboutIntro: Shawe Mal helps people rent houses, hire movers, and find roommates — with verified agents and drivers you can trust.
public.aboutPillarHousingBody: Browse and book homes with clear fees, amenities, and location details from verified housing agents.
public.aboutPillarMovingBody: Request a move with inventory and cargo details, then track driver acceptance and delivery status.
public.aboutPillarRoommatesBody: Publish lifestyle preferences and browse compatible roommate posts filtered by city, occupation, and gender.
public.aboutTrustBody: Agents and drivers complete registration and admin verification before they can publish listings or accept moving jobs.

home.newPlaceTitle: Your New Place. Your New Chapter.
home.newPlaceIntro: Find a home that fits your needs, connect with the right people, and arrange your move — all in one place.
home.newPlaceItem1Body: Find your home, connect with roommates, and arrange your move without switching between multiple platforms.
home.newPlaceItem2Body: Connect with housing agents and moving partners through verification, reviews, and transparent information.
home.newPlaceItem3Body: Discover housing, roommates, and moving options based on your needs, preferences, budget, and location.

home.howItWorksStep2Body: If you need a roommate, explore people who match your lifestyle, preferences, location, and budget.
home.howItWorksStep3Body: Select what you're moving, get a suitable vehicle recommendation and estimated cost, then schedule your moving service.
home.howItWorksStep4Body: After booking, receive clear updates from driver acceptance and arrival through loading, transportation, unloading, and delivery.

moving.subtitle: Submit a moving request with inventory counts, vehicle type, and cargo photos.
moving.sloganSubtitle: Connect with verified agents and trusted moving partners.
moving.easyStepsTitle: Your on-demand move in 4 easy steps
moving.easyStep1: Choose where you are moving from and to, add street or landmark details, and drop pins on the map so drivers know exactly where to go.
moving.easyStep2: Select furniture, appliances, boxes, and other items, add floor details and a few photos, and pick your preferred moving date.
moving.easyStep3: Shawe Mal recommends a suitable vehicle from your items and route, then shows a clear estimated cost. Review it and confirm when you are ready.
moving.easyStep4: Get your booking confirmation and order number right away, then follow clear updates as your move progresses from pickup to delivery.
